escena: SCENE (recording session, podcast studio in Santiago, evening): THE SUBJECT IS LISTENING, NOT SPEAKING — verify it by these landmarks, not by mood: her MOUTH IS CLOSED and relaxed, no teeth, no mid-word shape; one hand is cupped over the ear cup of her headphones, pressing them in; her eyes are lowered and slightly unfocused, aimed at nothing in the room, and her gaze goes OUT of the frame towards whoever is speaking, never at the camera; her whole body is still and leaned very slightly forward. The broadcast microphone on its boom is in the frame in front of her, unused. The only light is the AZURE-BLUE glow of the editing screen just out of frame at the left, which rakes across her cheek, her knuckles and the rim of the headphones and falls to near black on the far side. A strip of ORANGE marking tape is wrapped around the base of the mic stand, the only warm colour in the picture, no more than three percent of the frame. She wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater. 85mm at f/1.8. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.
